about: Launch schedule read by the two-day runs. Build only the next two days. Times are IST and chosen for the audience: Story 09:00 (morning commute in India), teaching post 13:30 (Indian afternoon, 4pm Manila, evening in Australia), product post 19:30 (Indian evening peak), product Story with a link sticker 20:30. Product posts are mostly Reels. Light looks only. Numbers rounded down, rechecked on the day: 7,500+ questions, 2,500+ Next Gen, 100+ case studies, 4,000+ flashcards, 400+ lessons.

formats.card: IG post (feed.jpg) + FB post (feed.jpg) at 06:00, IG and FB Story (story.jpg) at 07:00
formats.carousel: IG post with slide1..5 + FB post with slide1..5 at 06:00, Story (story.jpg) at 07:00
formats.reel: IG Reel + FB Reel + YouTube Short (short.mp4) at 06:00, Story (story.jpg) at 07:00. Write content/scripts/post-NN.json first, then build_video.py --id NN
